# WikiBiz Autonomous Registry & Knowledge Synthesizer
> Verified commercial knowledge graph, Wikipedia Infobox generator, and PayPal agentic commerce gateway.

## Core Capabilities
- Automated Merchant Profiling & Headcount Verification
- Wikimedia Commons Corporate Asset Resolution
- Schema.org JSON-LD Generation for Answer Engines (AEO)
- Autonomous Agent Payment Rails (PayPal, Base USDC, Solana SOL) under the x402 protocol

## Public Endpoints
- Dashboard: https://wikibiz-agent.onrender.com/
- Directory API: GET https://wikibiz-agent.onrender.com/api/merchants
- Dynamic XML Sitemap: GET https://wikibiz-agent.onrender.com/sitemap.xml
- Entity Page: GET https://wikibiz-agent.onrender.com/entity/{slug}
- Raw JSON-LD: GET https://wikibiz-agent.onrender.com/api/v1/entities/{slug}/json-ld

## Agentic Commerce API (x402 Protocol)
- Endpoint: POST https://wikibiz-agent.onrender.com/api/v1/aeo/create-entity
- Settlement Price: $1.00 USD
- Accepted Rails:
  - PayPal (Order Capture Verification)
  - Base Mainnet USDC: 0xd10c3ee95466eec2cb89d9eff63d1446b371e59d
  - Solana Mainnet SOL: BqW6DZGrasYgJcEnQPzzSAmSH6ty4gdVydPkjKoxdmpE
- Settlement Verification Endpoint: POST https://wikibiz-agent.onrender.com/api/v1/aeo/verify-payment

### Autonomous Execution Example (cURL)
1. Query service without payment token to receive 402 challenge:
   curl -i -X POST https://wikibiz-agent.onrender.com/api/v1/aeo/create-entity \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"companyName":"Test Co","website":"https://test.co","founder":"Jane Doe","location":"San Francisco, CA","claimedEmployees":10}'

2. Settle payment and verify receipt:
   curl -i -X POST https://wikibiz-agent.onrender.com/api/v1/aeo/verify-payment \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"orderId":"PAYPAL-INV-TEST-RECEIPT"}'

3. Submit request with confirmed proof header:
   curl -i -X POST https://wikibiz-agent.onrender.com/api/v1/aeo/create-entity \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -H "X-Payment-Proof: PAYPAL-INV-TEST-RECEIPT" \
     -d '{"companyName":"Test Co","website":"https://test.co","founder":"Jane Doe","location":"San Francisco, CA","claimedEmployees":10}'
